summary: Current code and tests agree, but the prior note completion contract and owner ambiguity wording conflict with the new candidate flow.

findings.detail: The prior note reconciler contract closes after note generation, while the candidate extension must continue polling until candidates arrive or the session terminates.
The new story says multiple People SSOT matches are always ambiguous, while the existing contract permits a uniquely ranked project-context match.
Architecture scope says nine files while the current diff has fifteen files.

inspection_summary: Compared the new story and architecture with existing reconciler and owner SSOT contracts, current implementation, diff, and strict-head evidence.
judgment_delta: Current tests pass, but cross-story SSOT comparison exposed two contract wording conflicts and one stale scope count.
